headline: A 1994 executive order directs federal agencies to use energy and water more efficiently at government buildings and facilities.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Clinton, deals with how federal government facilities use energy and water. Based on its title, it directs federal agencies to improve energy efficiency and conserve water at the buildings and sites they run. No summary was provided, so specific targets, deadlines, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that operate buildings and facilities
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps to lower energy use and conserve water at their facilities.
They may have to carry out new practices or projects to save energy and water at the sites they manage.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 1994; no separate effective date was provided.
